text:
ria: Heads-up — saw a big KMS usage spike at 03:12 UTC tied to snapshot restores from backup-service. ~3k kms:Decrypt calls in ~60s. Can someone confirm if recent RBAC rollouts touched uploader roles? @morgan :eyes:

encops-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: KMS_USAGE_HIGH - key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/abcd-ef01 increased 6x. Alert id KMS-20260323-01

morgan: on it. Which backup-service cluster, staging or prod?

ria: prod-us-east-1 (backup-service-prod-2). CloudTrail filter shows many kms:Decrypt with principal arn:aws:sts::123456:assumed-role/backup-uploader-prod/... -> suspicious.

alex: did we deploy anything last night affecting iam or kms grants? I remember an RBAC cleanup around 21:00 UTC.

sasha: I merged a small RBAC tidy (PR #4821) but that was only for staging mappings, not prod. Jamal, did you touch prod?

jamal: I rolled a credential refresh to prod at ~02:50 UTC (PR #4899) that tightened rotation TTL to 7 days for uploader SA. I didn't change IAM policies though. Checking logs now.

ria: paste of CloudTrail snippet I pulled:

```
CloudTrail: 2026-03-23T03:11:55Z kms:Decrypt userIdentity:AssumedRole:backup-uploader-prod
Resource: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/abcd-ef01
RequestParameters: {ciphertextBlob: REDACTED}
```

ria: Also seeing a handful of kms:CreateGrant events around 03:10 — not sure if those predate the spike.

alex: check for ephemeral grants. Quick CLI to list grants:

```
aws kms list-grants --key-id abcd-ef01 --query 'Grants[*].{grantee:GranteePrincipal,iss:IssuingAccountId}'
```

morgan: I'll run a grant creation time diff vs deploy times and forward the CloudTrail filter for kms:CreateGrant + iam:CreatePolicy to Splunk.

sasha: Can we block new grants on that key temporarily? Setting a deny in key policy may be disruptive.

ria: Agree — a global deny might kill legitimate restores. We need a surgical approach: either block grants issued to the uploader SA or revoke uploader sessions.

jamal: I can revoke STS sessions for the uploader SA and rotate its long-lived creds. Rolling now, ETA ~10m.

encops-bot: ACTION: Created incident channel #incident-kms-1757771111, incident id INC-20260323-37

morgan: Good. Also enabling more verbose audit forwarding for that key (forward full CloudTrail entries and grant metadata to Splunk). I'll add an ingest rule.

ria: After creds are revoked, we need a postmortem: why did backup-service produce such a large number of Decrypts? Hypothesis: client retry loop + missing local caching of plaintext, causing repeated decrypts.

alex: I recall a recent agent change that removed a local prefix cache to reduce memory. Could be correlated. I'll grep for exponential retry patterns after 02:48.

sasha: On it — searching logs for "Decrypt failed" and "Retry" across backup-service-prod-2.

ria: Quick mitigation plan: 1) jamal revokes STS & rotate creds, 2) morgan turn on grant creation alert suppression only after we confirm legitimate grant owners, 3) throttle backup-service restores and patch agent to reduce retry/backoff, 4) postmortem + remediation (cache, rate-limit, better metrics).

jamal: creds revoked and new creds rolled. Watching traffic.

morgan: I see grant creation ceased after 03:15, decrypt volume is trending down. Splunk dashboard updated.

ria: Thanks. Please keep this thread updated with any new findings, and join the call in 5 if you can — coordination to patch agent + audit timeline.

morgan: joining call now.

(ends)
